condition.description:
The condition that will decide whether to render thenComponent or elseComponent.

While the condition type is being imported, a spinner will be temporarily shown,
this behavior cannot be changed but due to optimizations you may not see the spinner
in some cases.

When the condtion's useCondition method returns null, a spinner
will be shown unless {@link useElseComponentAsFallback} is set to true.

For possible condition types see mixins of UiSdlRenderingCondition.

useElseComponentAsFallback.description:
When true, the elseComponent will be rendered if the condition result is not defined.

The condition value can be undefined when the condition's useCondition method explicitly
returns null instead of a boolean.

Check the particular condition type documentation to know when that can happen, the condition may
have extra configurations to change that behavior too.

thenComponent.description: The component to render when the condition is satisfied.

elseComponent.description: The component to render when the condition is not satisfied.
